'''Togepi''' (Japanese: '''トゲピー''' ''Togepy'') is a Pokémon in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]]. Togepi first appears in ''[[PPP33|Eggcellent Togepi]]''. It considers {{MPJ|Pikachu}} and {{MPJ|Clefairy}} as its parents and tends to appear at random.

== History ==
[[File:Togepi Egg MPJ.png|thumb|left|150px|As an Egg]]
Pikachu and Clefairy meet Togepi when it was an Egg found lying around on a river. They mistaken it for a watermelon at first as it wasn't introduced to their time yet.
